newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuelan October car sales fall 34 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Venezuelan October car sales fall 34 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Total Venezuelan car sales fell 33.57 percent in October from the same period last year, but were up 24 percent from September, Venezuela's Automobile Chamber (Cavenez) said.

October saw a total of 6,414 vehicles sold (842 of which were imported) versus 9,484 sold in October last year (170 of which were imported). In September 1996 5,173 vehicles were sold, of which 450 were imported.
Accumulated sales for the year are down 35.79 percent at 45,540 units, according to Cavenez, versus 70,920 over the first ten months of 1995.
